environment.description: Apollo GraphQL server deployed on EC2 instance, exposed via Network Load Balancer (NLB) on port 4000 with TCP passthrough. No authentication middleware. MongoDB 6.0 on same VPC with no query validation. Security group allows inbound 4000/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0. Node.js 18 runtime.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB, TCP passthrough, no TLS termination
config.mongodb: MongoDB 6.0, no query shape validation, no audit logging
